_readme: Draft single source of truth for prices. NOT wired to the pages yet. Calculations live in lib/pricing.js and scripts/qa-pricing.mjs checks both. Anything with pendingConfirmation: true waits for the client's answer to `question` (null = not in the client questionnaire yet). Amounts are SEK.

sources.prislista: Prislista Ny 2026 privat.pdf, dated 2026-02-19. Only pages 1-3 of 7 were available.
sources.docx: Servicios privados .docx (website copy for each service)
sources.calculator: Formula found in the page's calculator; it does not appear in the price list

timeEstimate.note: Hours per visit = 1.57 + 0.0167 x m2. Not in the price list, so the client has never validated it.

minHours.question: Q14
minHours.note: Printed under the weekly/biweekly/monthly rates, before "Enstaka hemstädning"; unclear whether it also covers one-off cleaning. The calculator bills homes under about 25.7 m2 for less than 2 hours.
minHours.clientAnswer: Minst 2 debiterade timmar gäller alla tjänster

1.label: En gång i månaden
1.source: prislista p. 2: "En gång i månad 245 kr"

4.label: Varje vecka
4.note: hourlyRate null = rate by weekday. The calculator counts 4 visits a month, not 4.33.

onetime.label: Enstaka hemstädning
onetime.source: prislista p. 2: "270 kr/timme ink. moms efter Rut avdrag med Aurel städmaterial"

weekdayRates.source: prislista p. 2: "Måndag till onsdag: 200 kr/timmen", "Torsdag och fredag: 220 kr/timmen"
weekdayRates.question: Q13
weekdayRates.note: No weekend rates in the price list. The calculator shows 0 kr for weekly or biweekly cleaning on Saturday and Sunday.

material.question: Q15
material.note: The customer supplies products and washes the cloths; products supplied by the company are invoiced at an unstated price. One-off cleaning uses the company's material, but it is not stated whether that includes equipment such as a vacuum cleaner, nor whether the OBS applies to one-off cleaning.
material.clientAnswer: Enstaka hemstädning ingår Aurels material; abonnemang: kunden håller material

tiers.question: Q22
tiers.note: The 150 m2 band the site uses does not exist in the price list, which jumps from "101–149 kvm" to "Över 151 kvm: Offereras". The calculator charges 4 750 kr up to 150 m2 and quotes above. Filed under the area-threshold question Q22.
tiers.clientAnswer: Priset får aldrig understiga toppen av föregående intervall

soilingSurcharge.note: Unclear whether it is a flat 20 % or up to 20 %: the price list says "tilläggskostnad på 20%", the docx "upp till 20 procent". Only shown as a text notice on the page.

windowcleaning.includes: Rengöring av fönstrets bågar och damning av persienner

quote.source: prislista p. 3: "5 rum och kök eller större än 120 kvm - Offereras"
quote.docxText: För bostäder upp till 5 rum och kök eller max 120 kvm kan du få ett pris direkt via vårt formulär. För bostäder större än 5 rum och kök eller över 120 kvm lämnas offert.
quote.question: Q21
quote.note: The sources disagree on 5-room homes: the price list quotes them, the docx prices them directly and quotes only above 5 rooms, and neither gives a 5-room price. The calculator quotes 5 rooms and never asks for m2, so a 3-room home of 130 m2 gets a price instead of a quote.
quote.clientAnswer: 5 rum och kök eller över 120 kvm offereras

balconyOnly.question: Q20
balconyOnly.note: The calculator charges a flat 450 kr and applies the surcharges to it.

surcharges.question: Q20
surcharges.note: Each surcharge is +25 %, but the price list does not say how several combine. "compound" (what the calculator does) multiplies by 1.25 per surcharge; "additive" adds the percentages.
